name: InfoSearch
description: InfoSearch is a retrieval evaluation benchmark designed to assess instruction-following capabilities of retrieval models beyond content relevance. It spans six document-level attributes and introduces novel metrics to evaluate models' responsiveness to detailed user instructions.
evaluation_method: Strict Instruction Compliance Ratio (SICR), Weighted Instruction Sensitivity Evaluation (WISE)
reputation: A niche but increasingly cited retrieval benchmark in the instruction-following IR literature, though it is not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on instruction-following capabilities in retrieval models, covering six document-level attributes with new evaluation metrics.
